schema_name: AAYS shared page status panel index

entry_schema.final_ready: boolean, never true without real gate evidence
entry_schema.evidence_paths: array of repository relative evidence paths

discovery_rule: Treat every direct child folder under docs/chatgpt_status/ as a page candidate except _shared. Validate page_key from queue path and queue payload before execution.
panel_rules: Prefer task-level completed/status/heartbeat evidence over stale shared heartbeat.
Show stale heartbeat as blocker, not as success.
Show final_ready=false unless completed and gate evidence agree.
Show invalid queue contract errors directly in the panel.
Never hide missing script_path, missing allowed_paths, or missing safety flags.
